title: [TEXT - Max 60 chars. The concise main package title, e.g. Μαρόκο 9 Ημέρες]
slug: [TEXT - Lowercase Latin letters only (a-z0-9-), e.g. maroko-9-imeres. Optional, auto-generated if omitted]
subtitle: [TEXT - Subtitle displayed under the title on the single page]
card_subtitle: [TEXT - Short subtitle shown on the package card grid, e.g. 9 ημέρες / 7 νύχτες]
badge_text: [TEXT - Custom badge text on the card. Leave empty to auto-use Country name]
card_primary_tag: [TEXT - Custom first tag on the card. Leave empty to auto-use Holiday term]
card_secondary_tag: [TEXT - Custom second tag on the card. Leave empty to auto-use Category term]
destination: [TEXT - Destination or country name, e.g. Μαρόκο or Περού. Shown in the 3rd stat tile under images]
price_note: [TEXT - Note under price, e.g. τελική τιμή ανά άτομο με φόρους]
nights: [TEXT - Primary field: number of nights, e.g. 8 διανυκτερεύσεις. Duration is automatically derived as nights + 1]
duration: [TEXT - Optional. e.g. 9 ημέρες. If left empty, it is automatically calculated as nights + 1]
expiration_date: [DATE string in YYYY-MM-DD format - Package automatically hides after this date, e.g. 2026-10-31]
seo_title: [TEXT - Custom SEO Title for search engines, max 60 chars. Defaults to '{title} | Zoulakis Travel']
meta_description: [TEXT - SEO Meta Description for search engines, max 155-160 chars. Base on package language (Greek or English). Leave empty to auto-derive from subtitle]
focus_keyphrase: [TEXT - Primary SEO focus keyphrase, e.g. Μαρόκο πακέτο διακοπών. Auto-derived from destination if omitted]
title_en: [TEXT - English translation of package title, e.g. Morocco 9 Days. Optional]
seo_title_en: [TEXT - English SEO Title, e.g. Morocco 9 Days | Zoulakis Travel. Optional]
meta_description_en: [TEXT - English SEO Meta Description, max 155-160 chars. Optional]
focus_keyphrase_en: [TEXT - English SEO focus keyphrase, e.g. Morocco holiday package. Optional]
description_content:
[HTML - The main descriptive daily program / itinerary. Use standard paragraph (

), bold (), and italic () tags]
includes_content:
[HTML - List of included services. Must be formatted as an HTML list:
  • Item 1
  • Item 2
]
excludes_content:
[HTML - List of excluded services. Must be formatted as an HTML list:
  • Item 1
  • Item 2
]
general_info_content: [HTML - Flight info, luggage limits, hotel notes, entry requirements, etc.]
